items.title: Voice Chat with Agents
items.excerpt: Cursor adds realtime voice calls with agents on desktop, web and iOS: describe a change out loud, ask what an agent is doing and hear progress while the voice agent hands coding work to the chat agent ('Hey Siri, call Cursor').
items.rationale: Primary-source release: designers who build with Cursor can now describe UI changes out loud and hear agent progress on desktop, web and iOS, without typing prompts.

items.title: Agent Harness: Definition
items.excerpt: NN/g defines the agent harness - the software loop between an AI model and its tools - and explains how its context, permissions and limits shape what users can actually do with an agent.
items.rationale: NN/g gives UX teams a working definition of the agent harness, showing that context, permissions and limits, not just the model, decide what users can do with an agent.

items.title: Berrypicking still beats the single answer for search, even in the world of AI
items.excerpt: Marcia Bates' 1989 berrypicking model explains what single-answer AI search still misses: people gather, shift and revise across sources - a design brief for AI search interfaces.
items.rationale: A concrete brief for anyone designing AI search: users gather and revise across sources, so a single-answer interface should leave room to browse, compare and change direction.

items.title: Tell Your Story with Seedance 2.5 | Adobe Firefly
items.excerpt: Adobe announces ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model is now available inside Firefly, free to try. Seedance 2.5 itself launched earlier; the news is Firefly availability.
items.rationale: New availability: Seedance 2.5 video generation now runs inside Firefly, free to try, so designers can use it without leaving the Adobe workflow they already use.

items.title: Native is a floor, not a ceiling
items.excerpt: With AI, a polished look costs nothing; native system components bring what can't be drawn and move with the platform (e.g. Liquid Glass) one step ahead of what imitates it.
items.rationale: A practical design-system call: now that AI makes a polished custom look cheap, building on native platform components keeps behavior and platform updates such as Liquid Glass that imitations can't match.
